newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan Sept 1st 10-day trade surplus 98.85 bln yen.
newsitem.headline: Japan Sept 1st 10-day trade surplus 98.85 bln yen.

text.p: Japan's customs-cleared trade balance posted a 98.85 billion yen surplus in the first 10 days of September, down 69.5 percent from the same period a year earlier, the Finance Ministry said on Thursday.
This compared with a trade surplus of 235.61 billion yen in the first 10 days of August.
Free on board (FOB) exports rose 5.9 percent to 1.17 trillion yen from a year earlier, while cost, insurance and freight (CIF) imports rose 37.3 percent to 1.07 trillion yen.
